text:
deploy-bot: Canary finished: inference-api v3.11.2 -> prod-us-east (canary 10%). Starting post-deploy smoke probes: healthcheck, embed-echo, kv-prefill. run=sniff-3180000001
rex: quick flag: embed-echo 5xxs spiked to 1.8% around 00:12, seems concentrated on shard=us-east-a. p95 latency ~stable.
june: logs show repeated connection resets from gw-3 to svc-a12: `[sniff] 00:12 embed 502 gw-3 -> svc-a12 reason=conn-reset`
maya: svc-a12 was part of a recent maintenance window and got new kernel packages. Could be subtle regressions in socket handling.
ops-bot: auto-mitigation: did not trigger failover because route affinity pinned canary to svc-a12 by host-affinity rules in rollout policy.
rex: that's the problem — affinity shipped in the canary config to optimize cache locality but concentrated traffic on a node with recent changes. recommend pause and remove affinity or shift canary off the host.
june: agree. options: 1) pin back to v3.11.1 2) patch rollout to remove host-affinity and rebalance 3) evict svc-a12 from canary via scheduler. Minimal blast approach = scheduler eviction.
maya: eviction sounds good. ops-bot can you prepare a scheduler exclude command?
ops-bot: prepared: `rdctl scheduler-weight --service inference-api --region prod-us-east --exclude-host svc-a12 --duration 15m --note "sniff-502-host-affinity"`
deploy-bot: Executing exclude. Canary traffic will rebalance over 45s. Sniffer paused for focused check.
rex: re-run focused embed-echo probe now. early numbers: 5xxs dropped to 0.1% after rebalance. p95 normal.
june: will open issue RD-3422 to track host-affinity gating in release pipeline and add preflight that verifies no hard host-affinity unless explicit SRE signoff.
maya: also schedule a small canary on svc-a12 after it boots with extra socket tuning, but not part of main rollout.
ops-bot: exclude window will expire in 15m. If no recurrence, resume canary progression.
deploy-bot: Sniffer resumed and results look green. Holding at 10% for 10m per rollout policy.
